name: SikaWrap® FX-50 C
tagline: Carbon fibre string for structural strengthening and connection, and anchoring of SikaWrap® strengthening systems
summary: SikaWrap® FX-50 C is a unidirectional carbon fibre string, encased in a plastic envelope, which is used as near surface mounted strengthening and as fibre connector for the anchorage of SikaWrap® fabrics.
metaDescription: SikaWrap® FX-50 C is a unidirectional carbon fibre string, encased in a plastic envelope, which is used as near surface mounted strengthening and as fibre connector for the anchorage of SikaWrap® fabrics.
usage: Anchoring SikaWrap® carbon and glass fibre fabrics on concrete or masonry
Connecting SikaWrap® carbon or glass fibre fabrics through concrete or masonry structures
packaging: 25 m roll on a plastic reel dispenser

items.label: Construction
items.text: Unidirectional carbon fibre string encased in a plastic envelope

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store in undamaged, original sealed packaging, in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +35 °C. Protect from direct sunlight.

items.label: Dry fibre modulus of elasticity in tension
System structure
items.text:
The system build-up and configuration as described must be fully complied with and may not be changed.
Impregnating / laminating resin options | Sikadur®-300 Sikadur®-52
Anchorage resin | Sikadur®-330 Sika AnchorFix®-3001 Sika AnchorFix®-3030
Structural strengthening fabric | SikaWrap® carbon or glass fibre fabric
The embedded composite will have a diameter of approx. 10 mm. For detailed information on Sikadur®-330, Sikadur®-300, Sikadur-52, AnchorFix®-3001, Sika AnchorFix®-3030, together with the resin and fabric application details, please refer to the relevant Product Data Sheets and the Method Statements.

items.label: Laminate tensile strength
items.text:
~2 000 N/mm2 (related to fibre cross section)* | (EN 2561**)
*Impregnating resin: Sikadur®-300, Sikadur®-52
*Values in longitudinal direction of the fibres
** Standard adapted to fit sample shape

items.label: Laminate modulus of elasticity in tension
items.text:
~230 kN/mm2 (related to fibre cross section)* | (EN 2561**)
*Impregnating resin: Sikadur®-300, Sikadur®-52
*Values in longitudinal direction of the fibres
** Standard adapted to fit sample shape

items.label: Consumption
items.text: Anchor impregnation: 110–150 g/m SikaWrap® fabrics: Please refer to the relevant product data sheet

items.label: SUBSTRATE QUALITY
items.text: Minimum substrate tensile strength: 1.0 N/mm 2 or as specified in the strengthening design. Please also refer to the relevant Method Statement for further information.

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text:
Concrete must be cleaned and prepared to achieve a laitance and contaminant free, open textured surface.
Please also refer to the relevant Method Statement for further information.
